title: Connecticut Active Child Care Center Source Candidates
description: Privacy-scoped official Connecticut rows with literal ACTIVE Child Care Center credential status, retained as source candidates with temporal and identity limitations.
coverage_claim: Official rows matching the fixed ACTIVE Child Care Center predicate at collection time; not a denominator of all childcare businesses and not independent proof of current operation.
identity_rule: Preserve release-scoped source keys and credentials without cross-row or cross-source business merging.
geography_rule: Retain reported ZIP as separate ZIP5 and ZIP4 when valid; missing or non-ZCTA ZIP evidence remains an explicit gap. No coordinates or business polygons are inferred.
